what: Visual-lab A/B of useMarineWindData carrying served_valid_time (marineConformServed.js, DARK). A = the conform as on dev (flag off); B = LAB_FLAGS=__RAW_MARINE_CONFORM_SERVED_TIME__. One build, bracketed A1 B1 A2 B2.

build.from: claude/dazzling-tereshkova-dd52ca fa99b0c1e (code identical to the PR head)
build.env: REACT_APP_ICON_STORED_TAIL=true (as the dev deploy builds it), GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false

backend: offline only: serve_synthetic.py --thin-bounds 1 --models GFS,ICON,EURO --layers waves,swell_1,swell_2,wind_waves,wind on :4113 (production FastAPI code over synthetic 3-hourly data); SPA on :3187; the live backend was never contacted
voided: A first A/B (01:24Z-01:35Z) ran against ANOTHER session's SPA on :3113 (bundle main.72e816af, "build-bounds"): serve_spa.js had died with EADDRINUSE behind Start-Process. Discarded; the run script now checks the served main.<hash>.js and the flag chunk before each run.

verdict.rule: a step is systematic when A1 == A2, B1 == B2 and A != B (end state model/layer/hour/stride, or the end status line)
verdict.request_mix: by request START over the whole flow: erratic A1 51 / A2 51 (18 /grid, 31 /grid_series) vs B1 58 (21, 35) / B2 55 (20, 33); euro_steps A 13 / 13 (7 /grid) vs B 12 / 12 (6 /grid); hour_steps, model_switch_future, pan_zoom_future identical. Consistent in both pairs: the served clock changes request decisions on these flows. Initiator not attributed (no source maps in this build).
verdict.served_vs_asked_off_the_wire: marine /grid replies with served_valid_time != valid_time: 0 in every step of every arm; /grid_series frames: 0 to 3 per flow (of 48 to 439). The app asks series pages on the stored lattice, so the in-between-hour case (valid_time = the ask) is rare here.
verdict.instrument_note: marineSameInstant / exactMs / silent counts read the drawn record's dataMs, which only B fills on /grid commits: their A/B differences are the instrument reading the field, not app behaviour.
